title: The Law Concerning the Prophet Like Moses
description: God promises through Moses to raise up a prophet like him from among the people, whom they must listen to. The promise is linked to the people's prayer at Horeb asking not to hear God's voice directly. The Lord will put his words in the prophet's mouth and hold accountable anyone who does not listen. A prophet who speaks in the name of the Lord without being sent, or in the names of other gods, must die. The mark of a true prophet is that what he predicts in the Lord's name actually comes to pass.
